Scenario fixture: a11ycore-embed-text-alternative-present (“<embed> must provide a text alternative”)

This file intentionally includes edge cases to test eligibility, presentation-role exclusion, and whole-rule outcomes. Each test embed has a stable id of the form embed_case_XX.

A. Baseline (eligible)

01 — FAIL: visible <embed> with no accessible name
Missing name.
02 — PASS: aria-label provides name
ARIA name counts.
03 — PASS: aria-labelledby provides name
Company brochure ARIA idref name counts.
04 — PASS: title attribute (best-effort)
Title is accepted as a last resort.

B. Eligibility suppression (ineligible)

05 — INELIGIBLE: aria-hidden and not tabbable
Ineligible per helper.
07 — INELIGIBLE: inert ancestor
Ineligible per helper.
11 — INELIGIBLE: inside <template>
Non-composed template content is ineligible.
12 — INELIGIBLE: display:none
display:none makes it ineligible.
13 — INELIGIBLE: visibility:hidden
visibility:hidden makes it ineligible.

C. Eligibility exceptions

06 — FAIL: aria-hidden but tabbable (tabindex=0) stays applicable and must have name
Tabbable override => eligible; missing name => fail.

D. Guardrails: not excluded (still eligible)

08 — FAIL: opacity:0 should remain eligible
Opacity does not exclude; missing name => fail.
09 — FAIL: offscreen should remain eligible
Offscreen does not exclude; missing name => fail.
10 — FAIL: zero-size container should remain eligible
Zero-size does not exclude; missing name => fail.

E. Presentation role exclusion (like <img>)

14 — EXCLUDED: role=presentation and not focusable
Excluded by rule when not focusable.
15 — FAIL: role=none but focusable is applicable
Focusable => not excluded; missing name => fail.

End of fixture.
